conclusions: Removing the app registration does not erase the valve's RF association.
Removing batteries resets volatile enrollment state but preserves the paired endpoint and controller identifiers.
A 0x7f factory frame is a cold-boot sweep; a 0xff frame is the actionable long-press enrollment request.
White-flash successes with the old controller identifiers are retained-association rejoins and do not by themselves prove that a new assignment frame was accepted.
The stock assignment begins about 50.4 ms after the request ends; local failures at 50.8-51.5 ms overlap the valve's fallback copy.
The 20:05 trial proved that network-armed firmware must preserve a bounded valve session while the gateway listener is stopped for raw SDR capture; otherwise the node emits no assignment at all.

The 20:17 trial proved local assignment acceptance and paired identity transition, but also showed that selector-2 can resume at a later initial counter after a sweep retry; controller initialization must resynchronize forward before returning to exact transcript matching.
The next isolated firmware test uses a 47 ms software assignment delay, the previously validated selector-2 carrier, and retries on later 0xff sweep frames.
